english.title: Attempt rape of a female 16 years or over
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to rape **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE WOMAN..), a female aged sixteen years or over, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..)
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempt
to rape a woman

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the wording of the full offence see H558.
(ii) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
(iii) A prior conviction for an offence listed in Schedule 15 to the Sentencing Act 2020, may render the convicted person liable to a mandatory life sentence in relation to a second offence listed under that Schedule, as per section 273 (offender aged 18 or over but under 21 when convicted of the second offence or section 283 (offender aged 21 or over).
